content:
alex_marketing: Quick handoff: we have an analyst embargo for Tue 22 Mar 16:00 UTC. Need PR to run pre-briefs, confirm who gets early quote, and get legal sign-off on quote wording. @elaine_pr @maria_legal
press-bot: New embargo added • ID EMB-20260322-01 • reporter list attached
elaine_pr: Thanks — can you drop the analyst list + preferred windows? Also confirm whether quotes are cleared live or pre-cleared.
alex_marketing: here's the list:
- Taylor (AIInsider) — prefers mornings ET
- Priya (CloudWatch) — afternoons CET
- Kenji (DevScale JP) — mornings JST
We planned a 1hr slot for live pre-briefs (30m briefing + 30m Q&A) across timezones. We want to offer a pre-cleared quote to Taylor and Priya, live-only to Kenji.
sam_prod: Benchmark blurb for the packet:
```
Redwood Inference (v2) — 8k token streaming gen
p50 latency: 120ms (A100-40GB equivalent)
Throughput: 45 reqs/s sustained
Note: numbers measured on our internal config; env details in appendix.
```
maria_legal: Quick flags: cannot use "industry-first" or absolute uptime claims. Suggest rewording the quote to: "We're excited to deliver materially lower latency and predictable economics for production LLM workloads." Also need attribution lines for benchmarks (hardware + config).
elaine_pr: Got it — will adjust quote requests. @alex_marketing please confirm the final quote text we send to analysts.
alex_marketing: Draft CEO quote (please vet): "By making inference predictable and cost-effective, we're enabling product teams to ship LLM features without guessing at economics or latency tradeoffs." — can legal trim?
maria_legal: Good direction. Change "without guessing" -> "with clarity about economics and latency tradeoffs." Also add: "— Redwood Inference" at the end for attribution.
elaine_pr: Recording policy: are pre-briefs allowed to be recorded? We normally prohibit recording for embargoed pre-briefs unless pre-agreed.
liya_ops: Confirmed: no recordings without explicit written consent from PR + legal. We'll add a one-line consent in calendar invites.
elaine_pr: Scheduling plan: I'll set three invites with explicit embargo text and add the pre-cleared quote as an attachment for Taylor & Priya. Kenji will get live Q&A only.
press-bot: Reminder • Embargo window: 2026-03-22 16:00 UTC — any early leaks must be reported. Policy: 72h escalation window.
alex_marketing: Thanks team — please tag me when invites + final quote copy are ready. Target: invites out by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
elaine_pr: Will do. tagging follow-ups: @maria_legal for final signoff, @sam_prod for appendix, @alex_marketing for quote lock.
press-bot: Thread archived to /press/embargo-log after last message.
